description: Translate the aftermath of Armamon's defeat and Kiriha's allies, MESPAK02 entry 11.

english: I understand what Armamon wanted... I'm a Weapon Digimon, so I can't just abandon him. Are you both ready?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: W-wait! I haven't finished talking...!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: It's okay! I'll stop Armamon's rampage and come right back! Bye!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: ...It's all right. Everything will be okay. Taiki, Shoutmon... Dynasmon... Everyone made me strong. I'm sure it'll work out. Thank you, everyone... Now it's my turn to save you!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Taiki! Shoutmon!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: ...Huh? Akari... Wait, what was I doing...?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Hey, Shoutmon! Are you all right?!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: He is only unconscious. His injuries are minor.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: What a lightweight! Get up, brother!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: ...Huh?! What's going on? Why is everyone here? Did something happen?!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Ballistamon reports: no damage at all.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: That's one tough hide, bro!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: By the way, Taiki, what happened? There was a huge tremor and a loud noise... It sounded like a massive explosion. Then you two suddenly appeared!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: That wasn't a normal teleport. It looked like you were blasted here from somewhere.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Blasted... here...?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Taiki... Did something happen to Spadamon?!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Everyone, it's a miracle! The data disturbance in Lost Space has disappeared! If it had kept spreading, it would've been a disaster. It vanished right after you came back... Could it be thanks to you?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: ...It was thanks to Spadamon.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: ...Huh?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Hey, where's Spadamon?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Right... Where is Spadamon? Only you two appeared here.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Spadamon probably won't be coming back...
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: He stayed behind in Lost Space to stop that huge Weapon Digimon's rampage...
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: That idiot... Spadamon...!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Phew! That was close! I barely made it out!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Spadaaaamon!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: What?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: ...No way.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Spadamon! Thank goodness you're safe! You had us worried!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Shoutmon was already bawling his eyes out...
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Sh-shut up, Ballistamon! Don't say stuff like that!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Spadamon! You made it out all right?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Yeah. It was close, but I escaped just in time.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Everyone, it's okay now! Armamon disappeared along with the black hole! I think he went back to the same place as Dynasmon.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: What happened to Lost Space?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Lost Space itself should now be open to travel, just like the other areas. I completely sealed off every dangerous part. But there's still a lot we don't know, so let's keep watch and think it over for a while.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Spadamon, you've changed a little. You're suddenly so dependable!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: W-well! That's thanks to my excellent training! You were a crybaby when we first met. A guy can't cry anymore, okay?!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Yeah, thanks, Shoutmon. ...So wipe those tears, okay?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Spadamon, you did such a wonderful job. While you were away, everyone told me you were one of the last Weapon Digimon. I knew there was something special about you!♪
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: By the way, Spadamon, what will you do now? Armamon and Dynasmon are both gone...
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: I've decided! As the last Weapon Digimon, I'll protect Elestou Zone from now on! So, Taiki... Will you become my warrior?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Your warrior...?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: When a Weapon Digimon finds someone it can entrust with all its power, it asks them to become its warrior! I'll become your sword. This is the proof of our bond.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: ...Whoa! Taiki, is that...?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: A Code Crown?!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: That's right. The Code Crown is given by Elestou Zone's ruler to the person I should serve.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: All right! I got a Code Crown!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Key item acquired! Code Crown
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Equipment acquired! Elestou Sword
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Equipment acquired! Elestou Shield
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: ...Oh no. I gave it to him...
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Huh? Was that a bad idea?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: It's not bad... but are you really sure, Taiki?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Sure about what?!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Hey, Spadamon! Explain properly!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Hehe! I was so happy, I skipped a step.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Wait... What does that mean?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Whoever receives this Zone's Code Crown has a duty to train a Weapon Digimon until it's strong enough to protect the Zone. So you can't leave until that's done, okay?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Whaaaaaat?!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: It's okay! I've gotten pretty strong, so it shouldn't take too long! Everyone, let's keep working together!♪
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: ...I don't mind. I like Sky Fort, so I could stay for a while! There are probably areas I haven't seen yet, too!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Oh! Then I want to go to Earth Fort! A secret base inside a giant machine... That's a guy's dream!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Well, that sounds nice. It'll be fun... Let's support the Digimon here for a while!♪
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: All right, Spadamon! I'm going to train you hard, so get ready!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Enter Lost Space?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Yes, enter.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: No, stay here.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Return to Sky Garden?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: I... I saw lightning strike right in front of me... Then everything went dark, and I passed out... What happened to Barbamon and Kiriha after that?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: ...Barbamon sent Kiriha to another Zone. Damn it! I couldn't do anything...!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Parrotmon... Thank goodness the aerial squad is safe!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: You're safe... Team Xros Heart.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Kiriha was sent away...?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: MailBirdramon?! And Greymon... You're safe, too?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Kiriha reloaded us when he saw an opening. He told us to help you if anything happened to him.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: We'd been tracking ROG's movements from the start. We were close to solving this Zone's mystery... I never thought Barbamon was secretly controlling ROG.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: What will you do now?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: I already told you: we'll help you. Barbamon's Shadow Guard took the Capacitor Towers. We'll need more strength from now on... So we'll lend you ours.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: ...I appreciate that, but...
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Are you two sure about this?
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Don't misunderstand. We only follow Kiriha.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Hmph... That's a pretty irritating way to put it!
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: We'll help you until Kiriha returns to this Zone.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Thank you, both of you... Kiriha will be all right. Knowing him, he won't go down easily.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Kiriha thinks highly of you.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.

english: Don't do anything that will disappoint him.
blocks.review_note: Armamon's defeat, Spadamon's return and Code Crown choice, followed by the Graymon/MailBirdramon alliance scene.
